culprit_citations.quoted_text: Consolidated Schedule of Investments as of March 31, 2026 (unaudited) and December 31, 2025 | 2

findings.detail: The checked population appears to include both March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025 schedule leaves, doubling the denominator from the 103 current-period leaves to 206.

rationale: B01 is an aggregate completeness flag: 103/206 leaves have fair_value. The raw source identifies one consolidated schedule covering March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025, and the schedule totals show separate current-period and comparative-period investment totals. The source current-period schedule has fair-value totals, so the 50% metric is best explained by comparative-period leaves entering the report-date population rather than by legitimate missing fair values in the source.
